span.p:
Pac-Man: 12 sprites of 12 frames,
30-frame pause.
Ms. Pac-Man: 30 frames mouth down,
10 quarter turns of 7.5 frames, mouth
up, then gone (159 frames);
7-frame pause; the sound starts with the spin.
